annotation.authors_or_issuer: Joint Committee of Public Accounts and Audit, Parliament of Australia
key_provisions_or_claims: Add AI use and understanding questions to the annual APS Employee Census.
Convene a whole-of-government working group within 12 months to consider standalone AI legislation and mandatory rules.
Mandatory rules should bar AI surveillance of public sector staff and set thresholds for AI in decision making.
Establish a statutory Joint Committee on AI and Emerging Technologies for continuous parliamentary oversight.
Guidance from the Digital Transformation Agency should clearly define AI systems, with separate guidance for each type.
annotation.summary_en: Report 510 of Australia's Joint Committee of Public Accounts and Audit, February 2025, on public sector use and governance of AI. It makes four recommendations: add AI questions to the APS census, convene a working group on AI legislation and mandatory rules, create a statutory Joint Committee on AI, and require clear AI definitions in guidance.
annotation.title_clean: Report 510: Inquiry into the use and governance of artificial intelligence systems by public sector entities - 'Proceed with Caution'
